name: Leviathan Spear
author: Glutoblop
description: Shows a countdown icon over spears you've thrown, then lets you dodge roll to recall them to an empty hotbar slot.

changelog.0.1.1: Mod Settings button in the pause menu: change this plugin's settings in game (one tab per plugin). Fixed the spear icon not lining up with the spear when render scale is below 100%.
changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: icon with a 10 s countdown ring over thrown spears within 20 m; dodge roll to recall a ready spear to an empty hotbar slot.
